name: Logical-or assignment writes a nil target once and short-circuits a truthy one

input.source_text: let mut runs = 0; class P { public fun rhs() { runs = runs + 1; :set } } let p = P.new(); let mut x = nil; let written = (x ||= p.rhs()); let mut y = :kept; let skipped = (y ||= p.rhs()); [written, x, skipped, y, runs]

applicability.reason: Pure Iris source has no native boundary.
